title: Lease kept alive by the per-tool-call hook (chat session id + slot path)
acceptance: 7 days with 0 lease-expire or foreign lease-break on a slot whose chat made a tool call in the last 30 min
notes: Built 2026-11-12: hooks/guard-tooluse.ps1 binds a chat to the lease and refreshes it on every tool call; agentq counts a recent refresh like a live owner. Suite lease chat 30/30 (guard under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7); 5 mutants caught. Baseline 7 days: 186 lease-break and 41 lease-expire. Open: the 7-day count after the install; slo prints it as slotsLostLiveChat

title: Land gate runs in the slot on the rebased tip before the land ticket is taken
acceptance: Busiest repo: land wait under 5 h a week, land failures under 10 %
notes: Built 2026-11-12: land runs the gate in the leased slot on the rebased result and exits 6 before the queue when it fails (config landPregate, landPregateRounds). Suite land pregate 31/31; 2 mutants caught. Baseline 7 days, busiest repo: 17.7 h land wait, 25.1 % failed lands. Open: the same numbers for 7 days after the install

title: Skip the in-queue gate for a tree hash that already passed
acceptance: A re-land of an unchanged green tree spends under 1 min in land
notes: Built 2026-11-12: a tree that passed a gate command is remembered for greenTtlHours and not gated again in the queue (journal land-gate-skipped-green). Covered by suite land pregate; 1 mutant caught. Open: the time in land of real re-lands after the install

title: Agent admission by load: no new task lease or build grant while the machine is saturated
acceptance: Process-start probe median under 500 ms in 95 % of 5-minute buckets on a working day
notes: Built 2026-11-12: agentq probe, config admission, status line LOAD; a waiter held longer than maxHoldMin is admitted anyway and the one build a saturated machine starts is the first in rank. Suite admission 48/48 with a faked probe; 4 mutants caught. Open: the bucket share of a working day after the install; slo prints it as startProbeBucketsPct

title: Admission follows owner presence and a night schedule
acceptance: Agent limit changes with input idle time and with the schedule; both visible in status
notes: Built 2026-11-12: config agentLimit (present, away, night window); status line AGENTS and the agents object in status -Json; journal agent-limit-hold. Limits that are not set mean taskSlotsMachine, so the shipped config changes no limit. Suite admission case 8; 3 mutants caught. Open: the status line on the installed copy

title: Prune agents, jobs, notices, releases and empty queue folders
acceptance: State folder file count stable over 7 days
notes: Built 2026-11-12: agentq prune, run by sweep. Suite prune 61/61. Before: 8870 files in the state folder (4089 agents, 3481 jobs, 619 notices). Open: the file count 7 days after the install

title: status is read-only (no reaping or capacity rewrite on a read)
acceptance: status leaves every file in the state folder unchanged (hash before = after)
notes: 2026-11-12: on a copy of the live state folder, 3 runs each: the old status changed 7, 1 and 1 files (queues, journal); the new one changed 0, 0 and 0. Median 14.1 s before, 9.2 s after. Suite status readonly 21/21; 1 mutant caught. Dead tickets are reaped by working verbs and by sweep

title: Shared clone on refuse for repos that have slots (ADR 0004)
acceptance: shared-write events for those repos drop to 0, overrides journaled
notes: 2026-11-12: the shipped config sets refuse for the two repositories with the most slots (101 of 6624 shared writes in the baseline 7 days); the guard now reads the mode under Windows PowerShell 5.1 (it was ignored there). Refuse is delivered as a warning with the lease recipe, because the guard is warn-by-default: the count can fall but nothing is blocked. Suite guard shared 20/20; 1 mutant caught. Open: the 7-day count after the install

title: PowerShell suites run in CI
acceptance: Every push runs run-all on a Windows runner; red blocks the merge
notes: 2026-11-12: job ps in .github/workflows/ci.yml runs every suite on pull requests and on pushes to main. Trial run 43184985180 on windows-latest: 40 suites, 0 failed, 26 min.
